def arms(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return (a[50][30],a[60][30],a[55][25],a[55][35],a[55][30])
# check piece position first
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
    if 17<=r0<=22 and n['color'] in ('b','S'): print("piece:", n['color'], c0, c1)
print("arms before:", arms(current_frame))
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':35}])
print("after R:", arms(current_frame), "changed:", r.get('board_changed'), "done:", r.get('done'), "lvl:", r.get('level_completed'), "step:", current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
